description: The review proposes translation among symbol systems as a construct: the process of mapping information contained in one or more symbolic forms into one or more other symbolic forms.
title: Symbol system translation as a problem-solving construct

description: The symbol systems approach holds that media can be \"usefully distinguished in terms of the symbol systems which they present and the kinds of symbol-using skills which they evoke, afford, or inculcate\".
title: The symbol systems approach to studying media and computers in education

description: The review organizes its analysis with Gardner's distinction between symbols, symbol systems, and symbolic products.
title: Symbol systems framework: symbols, symbol systems, and symbolic products

description: The essay locates Goffman in the symbolic interactionist tradition of Mead, Blumer, James, Cooley, Dewey and Thomas, a tradition favoring field research over laboratory studies and armchair writing.
title: Symbolic interactionism: individuals and society as inseparable, held together by changing shared symbols

description: Syntactic dissimilation is a transformational process operating on cognate constructions, in which the object holds the same meaning as the verb.
title: Syntactic dissimilation: cognate verbs replaced by pro-verbs

description: The SET model is a knowledge-based recommendation system that traces the latent causes of a student's systematic errors using a bipartite graph linking causes to errors, derived from the Ising model.
title: Systematic Error Tracing (SET) model

title: Systems change defined as shifting the conditions that produce and hold societal problems in place
